Stack RGB + per-band MS orthomosaics into a single GeoTIFF

Source: R/dji_mavic_3m.R
stack_dji_mavic_3m_ortho.Rd

Reads the 3-band RGB ortho plus up to four single-band MS orthos and resamples each MS layer onto the RGB grid (bilinear). The output band order is Red, Green, Blue, MS_G, MS_R, MS_RE, MS_NIR — matching default_dji_mavic_3m_band_map() — so downstream read_multispectral_orthomosaic() auto-detects it.

Usage

stack_dji_mavic_3m_ortho(rgb_ortho, ms_orthos, out_path)

Arguments

rgb_ortho

Path to the RGB ortho (3 bands; ODM convention is R/G/B).

ms_orthos

Named character vector of paths to MS-band orthos. Names must be among MS_G, MS_R, MS_RE, MS_NIR. Missing bands are silently skipped (the resulting stack still works, it just exposes fewer indices).

out_path

Destination GeoTIFF path.

Value

The out_path, invisibly.
